Appearance
From Wiktionary, the free dictionary
See also: Perilla, perillà, and perillä

English

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From translingual Perilla (genus name).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /pəˈɹɪl.ə/
  • Rhymes: -ɪlə

Noun

[edit]

perilla (countable and uncountable, plural perillas)

  1. An East Asian herb with flavorful leaves used in cooking and as a garnish, Perilla frutescens. Also grown for the seeds, which contain an edible and industrially-useful oil.
    • 2015, Han Kang, translated by Deborah Smith, The Vegetarian, Granta, published 2018, page 42:
      The smell of burnt flesh, which the perilla seeds couldn't wholly mask, pricked my nose.

Synonyms

[edit]
  • beefsteak plant (purple-leaved variety)
  • shiso

Derived terms

[edit]
  • perillaldehyde
  • perillyl

Translations

[edit]
East Asian herb
  • Catalan: alfàbrega japonesa f
  • Chinese:
    Cantonese: 紫蘇 / 紫苏 (ji2 sou1)
    Mandarin: 紫蘇 / 紫苏 (zh) (zǐsū)
  • Daur: bal
  • Finnish: veripeippi (fi)
  • French: perilla (fr) f, pérille (fr) f, pérille de Nankin (fr) f
  • Japanese: 紫蘇 (ja) (シソ, shiso)
  • Korean: 들깨 (deulkkae), 깻잎 (ko) (kkaennip) (leaves)
  • Nepali: सिलाम (silām)
  • Russian: пери́лла (ru) f (perílla), судза́ f (sudzá)
  • Vietnamese: tía tô (vi)

Anagrams

[edit]
  • pallier

Catalan

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central, Balearic) [pəˈɾi.ʎə]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [peˈɾi.ʎa]
  • Rhymes: -iʎa

Verb

[edit]

perilla

  1. inflection of perillar:
    1. third-person singular present indicative
    2. second-person singular imperative

Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From pera +‎ -illa.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • IPA(key): /peˈɾiʝa/ [peˈɾi.ʝa]
  • IPA(key): /peˈɾiʝa/ [peˈɾi.ʝa] (Equatorial Guinea, most of Latin America and Spain)
  • IPA(key): /peˈɾiʎa/ [peˈɾi.ʎa] (Andes Mountains, rustic northern Spain, Paraguay, Philippines)
  • IPA(key): /peˈɾiʃa/ [peˈɾi.ʃa] (Buenos Aires and environs)
  • IPA(key): /peˈɾiʒa/ [peˈɾi.ʒa] (elsewhere in Argentina and Uruguay)

 
  • Rhymes: -iʝa
  • Rhymes: -iʝa (Equatorial Guinea, most of Latin America and Spain)
  • Rhymes: -iʎa (Andes Mountains, rustic northern Spain, Paraguay, Philippines)
  • Rhymes: -iʃa (Buenos Aires and environs)
  • Rhymes: -iʒa (elsewhere in Argentina and Uruguay)

  • Syllabification: pe‧ri‧lla

Noun

[edit]

perilla f (plural perillas)

  1. goatee
    Synonyms: (Mexico) piocha, barba de chivo, chiva, chivera
  2. knob, doorknob
    Synonyms: manecilla, pomo

Further reading

[edit]
